notes: Lich force Omens compatible Bone families: Jawbone yes, ordinary Collarbone yes; Rib, Cranium, Vertebrae, Altered Collarbone no. Used where the wiki does not state Cranium/Vertebrae explicitly.
Known anomaly: the 'Gain (3-6) Rage on Melee Hit' suffix is documented as belonging to Kurgal despite conflicting Ulaman naming/data.
Unique-item custom Desecration systems (Undying Hate, Grip of Kulemak, The Unborn Lich, etc.) are unsupported in MVP; Time-Lost Jewels must never be treated as ordinary jewels.
Mark of the Abyssal Lord: prefix form 'Abyssal' or suffix form 'of the Abyss'; distinguish from jewel-exclusive 'of the Abyss' by mod-ID matching.
Known Bone set and targets; armour includes shields/foci where the data classifies them as armour-compatible (SoT §2.1).
